head: A Japanese taste for Tasmanian soba put 300 cherry trees along a Tasmanian river.
summary: Buckwheat trials began in Tasmania in 1986, and its reversed seasons let Japanese millers buy fresh soba flour twice a year. Mill owner Rick Shiratori donated the cherry trees thirty years ago in thanks, and 300 now line the Meander River at Deloraine, blooming for about ten days. Around 200 people came on Sunday to the fifth Hanami Trail festival for aikido, taiko drumming and bamboo flute.
